info.description: Workspaces, use cases and lifecycle stages. Each use case's engine API is served behind /w/{workspace}/u/{use case} (see the engine contract).
info.title: Autology platform API

get.summary: The caller's workspace and the use cases they may open

post.summary: Propose a grant; it takes effect once another person with authority approves it

post.x-autology-permission: approver (person, not the proposer, not the grantee)

get.summary: Members, their grants, pending grant proposals and the administration history (ADM-1)

post.summary: Add a member; the token is returned once
Revoke a member's grant on one use case, at once
Replace a member's token; the new one is returned once

get.summary: Use cases of the caller's workspace

post.summary: Create a use case from a template

get.summary: One use case with its stage history

post.summary: Make a saved, valid draft revision this use case's ontology, then reload; needs a release to run (STU-6)

get.summary: Releases, the active one, and whether the running configuration drifted (REL-1a)

post.summary: Propose a release of the configuration the engine runs now

get.summary: One release (with its snapshot for administrators and release approvers)

post.summary: Activate an approved release that is exactly what runs (a rollback when it is older)
Approve a release, bound to its fingerprint (D11)
Put a release's ontology back and reload; activate the release afterwards to roll back

post.x-autology-permission: the approver or a workspace admin

post.summary: Reload the engine from its files without a restart; not an activation (ADM-2)
